text: Hi Priya, your laptop is back from the staging bench with a fresh ghost image on it. Your old profile files are in the Lumen share under a folder called recovered, so please check that before you sign in. Let me know if anything is missing.
Ticket 48213 is closed. The printer on the third floor was not talking to PrintFlow because the queue was paused from last Friday's update. I unpaused it and sent a test page, it printed fine.
Marisol, quick heads up, we have a lockout storm on the Halyard service account again. Teodor is looking at the domain controller logs now, do not reset anyone's password until he says so.
Thanks so much for the quick turnaround yesterday Kofi. The new hire laptops are in the hold queue until Sunita confirms start dates, so I will image them Monday morning.
Can you swing by closet 3B before lunch? The Badgeline reader on the loading dock stopped taking cards after the firmware push and I want to look at it with you.
Hal from Corvane says the replacement switch ships Wednesday. Teodor wants it racked in the Hollis building closet, not the old one, so update the stack ID in Snipe-IT before you close the change.

Hi Renee, your MFA reset is done. Open the Authenticator app, scan the new code, then sign in from your desk machine first. If the prompt keeps looping, call me at my desk line and we will do it together.
I swept the tombstone accounts from the Q2 leavers list and parked the orphan mailboxes in the quarantine bucket. Nothing got deleted, the retention hold still covers them for ninety days.
Brynn finished the Win11 base image on Friday. We are doing a dock swap on the 4th floor this week, so anyone with a docking station on the old model should go into the hold queue first.
Lunch is at noon, I am bringing the good coffee. Also the cutover window for Lumen moved to Saturday night, so do not plan anything Sunday morning please.
Ran the sysprep and TPM pin check on the loaner pool units, three of them still had BitLocker recovery keys stored in the old escrow. Re-escrowed them and logged it under the Lumen change.
Sunita, the badge for the new analyst in Finance is active but she cannot reach the shared drive. Her group membership replicated late, so give it another hour before you escalate it to Teodor.
Okay so the jump box rebooted itself during patching and dropped two RDP sessions. Not a security incident, just the auto-restart policy. I have set it to notify before reboots from now on.
Hi Dana, I can see your ticket for the Outlook profile that keeps rebuilding itself. It is a corrupted OST, not the policy. I cleared the cache and it should stay put now.

Note for the knowledge base: when a reimage hangs at the Sysprep specialize pass, check the network driver first. Most of the time it is the USB ethernet adapter that never got its drivers injected into the image.
Hal says Corvane will credit the two bad optics but they want the RMA number in writing. Please send them the serials from the tickets and cc Marisol so she has the thread.

Teodor wants the VLAN for the Badgeline readers moved off the guest network before cutover. Put the change on the calendar for Thursday evening and loop in Kofi since facilities depends on those doors.
Finished the sweep on the Hollis floor. Eleven stale wall jacks are patched in the closet, and the two printers that never got a stack ID are now tagged. Ticket is ready for review.
Quick question, is the loaner pool still on the Halyard queue or did Brynn move it to the asset board? I need to know before I pull three laptops for the Thursday onboarding batch.

Thanks for flagging the duplicate mailbox, Renee. I merged the two into the primary and the orphan is in the quarantine bucket until the retention window closes. Let me know if anyone else sees the ghost calendar.
Good news on the lockout storm. The bad script was a scheduled task on an old build server, Teodor disabled it and the service account is clean. I wrote up the root cause for the postmortem doc.
Hi all, the Halyard upgrade is live. The priority field moved, so if your saved views look wrong, rebuild them from the default template. Ping me if a macro breaks, I already fixed the reopen one.

Kofi, the software license for the CAD suite expired on the 15th and the renewal PO is stuck in procurement. I can keep the seats alive on a grace period for one week, after that engineering loses access.

Sunita asked for the new hire packet to include the Badgeline card and the loaner laptop. Please do not hand over the card until the MFA enrollment is complete, we had two people walk away without it last month.
Just got off the phone with Corvane. The switch is racked, the optics are the real problem, and Hal will overnight the replacements. I put the closet in maintenance mode so nobody trips the alerts.
I think the printer on the second floor is fine, the issue was the cached driver on the three Macs. Removed it, reinstalled from PrintFlow, and the duplex option works now. Closing the ticket.
Brynn, can you check whether the ghost image still has the old Teams cache baked in? Two users reported stale meeting links after reimage and I do not want to ship that to the next batch.

Heads up, the password expiry notice went out to the wrong distribution list again. Marisol asked me to pull the template and resend to the right group, so ignore the first one, it was sent by mistake.
Okay the jump box logs are clean. The RDP gateway was fine, the problem was an expired cert on the bastion. Teodor renewed it and I added a calendar reminder so we catch it in January.
Hey, do you have a spare USB-C dock for the front desk? Their current one keeps dropping the monitor on wake. I can bring one up from the loaner pool if you want to try it before we order a new set.

Ticket reopened because the user says the Lumen share still shows the old project folder. I checked, the sync stalled on a long file path. I bounced the sync client and it caught up in about twenty minutes.
Thanks Dana, the Outlook profile is working again. I left a note in the KB about the corrupted OST so the next person does not spend an hour on it like I did. Have a good weekend.
The hold queue is down to nine laptops now. Brynn is imaging the rest tonight. Anything still in hold by Friday goes to the loaner pool so the onboarding batch is not blocked.

Marisol, I need approval to use the vendor credit on the replacement switch. It is about four hundred dollars under the threshold, so it should not need a second signature, but I want you to see it first.

Morning. The Badgeline readers in the parking garage were offline overnight. I checked the controller and the battery backup is fine, the switch port was just flapping. Teodor moved it to a clean port.
Renee asked whether her old laptop can be wiped and reissued. Yes, it is on the tombstone list, so I can do the reimage today, but she needs to back up her desktop folder to the Lumen share first.
Quick note on the cutover checklist. Step seven, flush the DNS on the file servers and confirm the old NAS is read only. Teodor added step eight for the printers, which I think we should keep.

Kofi says finance wants the asset report by Wednesday with every laptop tagged. I have about sixty items still missing a stack ID. I will go through the hold queue first since those are easiest to match.
Teodor, the new firewall rule for the Corvane management subnet is in. Test from the jump box only. If the switch does not come up after the reboot, roll back the rule first and then call Hal.

Hi, I am sorry the MFA prompt loop has happened three times this week for you. I have added your device to the trusted list. If it happens again, send me a screenshot and we will check the conditional access policy.
Lunch was good, thanks for covering the queue Brynn. Do not forget the Lumen cutover check on Saturday, I put it on the team calendar with the rollback steps attached.
New week, same mess. The lockout storm came back on Monday from a phone that was still syncing an old password. I wiped the device profile and the storm stopped by nine. Logging the cause now.
Priya's laptop came back from the staging bench, but the TPM pin was not set so BitLocker asked for the recovery key on boot. I have the key in escrow and I will read it to her over the phone.
Hal says the Corvane RMA for the optics is approved. They will ship to the Hollis building receiving desk, so please ask the front office to hold any boxes until I pick them up.

The printer on the fourth floor keeps jamming on the stapler finisher. It is a mechanical fault, not the driver. I opened a break-fix with the vendor and marked the device as out of service in Snipe-IT.
Sunita, I need the new hire start dates for next Tuesday's batch. Once I have them I will put the reimage and badge requests into the hold queue so nothing goes out late.
Teodor found a stale DNS record for the old NAS that still pointed at the wrong IP. I removed it and flushed the cache on the file servers. The Lumen share is reachable again from every floor.

Ticket 48301. The user cannot open a Teams link in Chrome but Edge works fine. This is the extension conflict we saw with the screen share plugin. I added the exception through Intune and it is fixed.
Brynn finished the new ghost image for the Hollis floor. It has the updated Defender policy and the PrintFlow driver baked in, so please test on one loaner before you roll out to anyone else.
Got the approval from Marisol on the vendor credit. Kofi is processing the PO this afternoon and I will confirm the replacement switch tracking number when it hits the Hollis receiving desk.

Quick reminder that the badge reader firmware is pinned to the version Teodor tested. Do not push the Badgeline update to the parking garage until we have the rollback plan written out and signed off.
Yeah I think the stale calendar is an orphan mailbox that never got tombstoned. I moved it to the quarantine bucket and the ghost meetings disappeared. Renee says it looks right now, so closing it.
Dana, I am going to sweep the guest accounts on Friday afternoon. Anything that has not logged in for ninety days goes to the tombstone list. If you need one kept, tell me before then.

The jump box patch window moved to Sunday. Teodor wants a full snapshot before the reboot, so please do not start any long reimage jobs that depend on it that night. I will send the final timing tomorrow.

Okay the cutover went mostly clean. Two printers did not come back on the new print server and the Lumen share had a permissions gap on the accounting folder. Both are fixed now and I am writing the summary.
Thanks everyone for the patience this week. The hold queue is empty and the loaner pool is back at eight units. Brynn will stage the next batch on Monday and I will send the list to Sunita.

Hi Renee, your old laptop is wiped and the new image is on. I restored your desktop folder from the Lumen backup, but the Chrome bookmarks are not in there, so you may need to export them from the old profile.
Corvane sent the revised RMA label for the optics. It has the wrong ship-to address so I called Hal and he corrected it. The new label is attached to the ticket, so please do not print the old one.

I am thinking about moving the reimage queue into Halyard as a standing workflow so we stop tracking it on the whiteboard. Can you look at the template with me Thursday? Tell me if you want the hold status field kept.

Lunch Friday? I owe you a coffee for covering the cutover night. Also the Badgeline garage readers are finally stable on the new firmware, so the next time someone complains about the door, it is probably a card issue.
